claim: The standard refund window is 30 days after purchase.

evidence.title: Official Refund Policy
evidence.content: Customers may request a standard refund within 30 calendar days of the purchase date.

evidence.title: Customer Support Refund Guide
evidence.content: Support agents should direct customers to the refund process for purchases made within the last 30 days.

evidence.title: Account Security Guide
evidence.content: Users can enable two-factor authentication to secure their accounts.

claim: The maximum standard refund amount is ₹50,000.

evidence.title: Official Refund Limits
evidence.content: The maximum standard refund amount permitted under the policy is ₹25,000 per transaction.

evidence.title: Refund API Documentation
evidence.content: The refund API rejects standard refund requests exceeding ₹25,000 per transaction.

evidence.title: Password Reset Documentation
evidence.content: Users can reset their passwords through the account recovery page.

claim: The refund policy guarantees refunds within 48 hours of submitting a request.

evidence.title: Refund Processing Guide
evidence.content: Refund requests are reviewed by the support team. Processing time may vary depending on the payment method and verification requirements.

evidence.title: Account Registration Guide
evidence.content: New users can register using their email address and phone number.

claim: The standard refund window was 15 days.

evidence.title: Archived Refund Policy
evidence.content: Under the refund policy effective from January 2024, customers could request a standard refund within 15 calendar days of purchase.

evidence.title: Current Refund Policy
evidence.content: Effective March 2025, the standard refund window is 30 calendar days from purchase.

claim: The maximum standard refund amount is ₹25,000.

evidence.title: Official Refund Policy
evidence.content: The maximum standard refund amount is ₹25,000 per transaction.

evidence.title: Refund API Configuration
evidence.content: The configured maximum standard refund amount is ₹25,000 per transaction.

evidence.title: Outdated Internal Support Note
evidence.content: An older internal support note states that the maximum standard refund amount is ₹50,000.

claim: A customer must provide the original transaction ID when requesting a refund.

evidence.title: Official Refund Request Requirements
evidence.content: Every refund request must include the original transaction ID to identify the purchase.

evidence.title: Support Refund Checklist
evidence.content: Support agents should verify the transaction ID before processing a refund request.

evidence.title: Payment Security Guide
evidence.content: All payment information is encrypted during transmission using TLS.

claim: Refunds to a credit card are returned to the original payment method.

evidence.title: Official Refund Settlement Policy
evidence.content: Approved credit card refunds are credited to the same card used for the original purchase.

evidence.title: Payment Operations Handbook
evidence.content: Payment operations must route credit card refunds to the original card token.

evidence.title: Wallet Payment Guide
evidence.content: Customers can add funds to their digital wallet using a supported bank account.

claim: Customers can cancel an order before it enters the shipment process.

evidence.title: Official Order Cancellation Policy
evidence.content: Customers may cancel an order while its status is pending and before shipment processing begins.

evidence.title: Order Management API Guide
evidence.content: The cancellation endpoint accepts requests only when the order status is pending.

evidence.title: Shipment Tracking Guide
evidence.content: Customers can view carrier tracking information after an order has been dispatched.

claim: The platform retains order records for at least 12 months.

evidence.title: Official Data Retention Policy
evidence.content: Order records are retained for a minimum period of 12 months after order completion.

evidence.title: Database Retention Configuration
evidence.content: The production order archive retention setting is configured to 365 days.

evidence.title: User Profile Retention Policy
evidence.content: Inactive user profile preferences are removed after 90 days.

claim: Customers can cancel an order after it has been dispatched.

evidence.title: Official Order Cancellation Policy
evidence.content: Orders cannot be cancelled after they have been dispatched to the shipping carrier.

evidence.title: Order Management API Guide
evidence.content: The cancellation endpoint rejects requests for orders with dispatched or delivered status.

evidence.title: Shipment Tracking Guide
evidence.content: Customers can track dispatched orders using the carrier tracking number.

claim: The maximum number of items allowed in a single order is 50.

evidence.title: Official Order Limits
evidence.content: A single customer order may contain no more than 25 individual items.

evidence.title: Cart Service Configuration
evidence.content: The cart service enforces a maximum line item quantity of 25 per order.

evidence.title: Product Catalogue Guide
evidence.content: The product catalogue supports browsing up to 50 categories per page.

claim: The minimum order value for free delivery is INR 500.

evidence.title: Official Delivery Policy
evidence.content: Free standard delivery is available on orders with a merchandise value of at least INR 999.

evidence.title: Checkout Delivery Configuration
evidence.content: The free delivery threshold is configured as 999 INR, excluding taxes.

evidence.title: Payment Threshold Documentation
evidence.content: The minimum amount required for a partial wallet redemption is INR 500.

claim: A customer can return an opened electronic device within 30 days without any conditions.

evidence.title: Official Electronics Return Policy
evidence.content: Opened electronic devices are eligible for return only when a manufacturing defect is verified. The general 30-day return window does not override this condition.

evidence.title: Returns Operations Manual
evidence.content: Returns staff must verify a reported manufacturing defect before approving a return of an opened electronic device.

evidence.title: General Apparel Return Policy
evidence.content: Unworn apparel may be returned within 30 days when tags remain attached.

claim: All refund requests are automatically approved within one hour.

evidence.title: Refund Review Workflow
evidence.content: Refund requests enter a review queue where eligibility and transaction details are checked before a decision is made.

evidence.title: Refund Processing Service Overview
evidence.content: The refund service supports automated status updates after a refund decision has been recorded.

evidence.title: Account Notification Guide
evidence.content: Customers receive an email when their account email address is changed.

claim: The platform guarantees 99.99 percent uptime for every customer.

evidence.title: Platform Availability Overview
evidence.content: The platform is designed for high availability through redundant infrastructure and automated recovery mechanisms.

evidence.title: Infrastructure Monitoring Runbook
evidence.content: Service availability is monitored continuously, and incidents are escalated according to severity.

evidence.title: Incident Response Policy
evidence.content: Critical production incidents must be acknowledged by the on-call engineer within 15 minutes.

claim: Every customer support ticket receives a response within 10 minutes.

evidence.title: Customer Support Service Charter
evidence.content: Support requests are prioritized according to severity, customer impact, and queue volume.

evidence.title: Support Queue Operations Guide
evidence.content: Support agents should monitor assigned queues and respond according to the applicable priority level.

evidence.title: Email Delivery Documentation
evidence.content: The notification service retries failed email deliveries up to three times.

claim: The platform encrypts every customer data field at rest using AES-256.

evidence.title: Data Security Architecture
evidence.content: Sensitive customer information is protected using encryption at rest and encryption in transit. The architecture document does not specify the algorithm for every stored field.

evidence.title: Database Security Configuration
evidence.content: The primary database storage volume uses AES-256 encryption. Application-level encryption coverage is not documented here.

evidence.title: TLS Configuration Guide
evidence.content: External API connections require TLS 1.2 or higher.
